text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I can't believe this. What is this?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest racer couldn't
even step
into the lead's shadow!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
choice_data_list: Let's win by a landslide next time.
What happened to your usual groove?
What happened to your usual groove?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...You really believe in me, don't you,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Let's win by a landslide next time.
What happened to your usual groove?
What happened to your usual groove?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You know deep in your heart that I can
win... and
that I can be the world's
strongest racer.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Right! This is no time to lose my spine!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I swear next time I'll win by a
landslide!
It'll be so easy, I'll even have
the energy to lift
you up on my
shoulders after!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I think I'm gonna go for a run real quick.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I need a little time to get back to my
normal self.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When I return... let's do some training
worthy of
the world's strongest racer!
